Chapter 906: Chapter 9: Hope (Please Subscribe)_2

For this reason, many forces in the thirty-three Immortal Domains, and even forces from the wilderness regions beyond the thirty-three Immortal Domains, wished to request Lin Yuan’s help with alchemy.

After all, in the Immortal Realm, the importance of an Alchemy Master is undeniable, with various kinds of Immortal Pills becoming an indispensable part of all immortals’ lives.

For many immortals, the significance of Immortal Pills even exceeds that of Immortal Artifacts.

“Master… what kind of power is it actually…”

Yun Zhenzi quickly finished reading all the letters, and couldn’t help but think of his attempt to seize Lin Yuan’s body, invading Lin Yuan’s Spirit World, and seeing that towering, high and mighty hazy figure.

Yun Zhenzi’s initial reaction was to wonder if he had tried to seize the body of an Ancestral Master, because aside from an Ancestral Master, at the level of a Jade Immortal, whose spiritual will could make him feel so hopeless?

“However, ever since I started serving my master, my strength and realm have indeed improved a lot…” Yun Zhenzi composed himself, realizing that in the past five hundred years, even the things that slipped through Lin Yuan’s fingers had benefited him greatly.

Especially when Lin Yuan occasionally produced ‘waste pills’ during alchemy… The ‘waste pills’ defined by Lin Yuan were, in Yun Zhenzi’s eyes, already of decent quality.

…

Inside the cave mansion.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Space slightly twisted in all directions. When comprehending the rules and the grand dao, even though Lin Yuan tried to reduce his interference with the surroundings as much as possible, he could not completely stop it.

In the past five hundred years, under the subtle influence of Lin Yuan, the space of the entire cultivation area had expanded countless times.

The grand Spatial-Temporal Maze spread out, centered around Lin Yuan, filling every inch of space in the cultivation area.

However, only Lin Yuan could enter the cultivation area. Yun Zhenzi was occasionally able to approach, but since the latter bore Lin Yuan’s aura seal, he wasn’t affected much.

One day, the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall paid a visit to Lin Yuan.

“Hahaha, Master Yun Zhenzi, I wonder if you’re still interested in crafting another batch of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills?”

The Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall asked with a smile, having found that the effects of the fifty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills that Lin Yuan had previously crafted were even better than imagined after detailed evaluation upon return.

“It would be an honor.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. The trade with the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall was very straightforward, and he was even paid in Origin Source for alchemy.

Lin Yuan naturally would not refuse.

Next.

The two discussed the details of alchemy, and Lin Yuan asked, “Does the Hall Master have any channels to purchase Origin Source?”

For Lin Yuan, he naturally could never have too much Origin Source, yet apart from a few powers like the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall who were willing to trade Origin Source as payment, others only offered top-quality Immortal Crystals or other precious resources in exchange for his alchemy.

“The Master desires Origin Source?”

Surprise appeared on the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall’s face; according to the Origin Source traded with Lin Yuan, it should have been enough for the cultivation of a normal Jade Immortal.

The consumption of Origin Source is not a matter of more being better; the environment briefly formed when Origin Source dissipates can pose a risk of ‘becoming dao’ for a long time, even for a Jade Immortal.

The so-called ‘becoming dao’ means returning everything back to the grand dao of heaven and earth.

To resist the ‘becoming dao’ effect of Origin Source for a long time, one can only rely on the spiritual willpower of the Jade Immortal itself.

But normally speaking, even the topmost Jade Immortals wouldn’t dare to cultivate too long in the kind of environment created by the Origin Source.

Of course, even if they can only engage in short-term cultivation, it is of great help to any Jade Immortal, which is also the reason why Origin Source is incredibly rare.

After all, Jade Immortals have long lifespans, and it’s nothing to them to contemplate Origin Source for a brief period after a long while.

“I will help the Master to inquire further.” The Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall nodded.

“Thank you.” Lin Yuan said.

…

The two continued their conversation for a while.

As if recalling something, the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall spoke in a low voice, “By the way, does the Master wish to hire some top Jade Immortals for protection?”

“Protect myself?” Lin Yuan was startled.

“Indeed,” the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall explained, “With the Master’s current alchemical expertise, while attracting some seekers of pills, it’s certain to also draw the attention of many with ill intentions.”

Although the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall did not state it explicitly, his meaning was quite clear.

Top alchemy masters are undoubtedly wealthy, and the wealth they accumulate is immense, attracting the notice of some formidable Jade Immortals.

As long as one can kill a top alchemy master, the wealth obtained would be enough to support their cultivation for a lengthy period.

Since ancient times, plundering has always been the quickest shortcut to amassing wealth. Lin Yuan is unwilling to plunder because alchemy is an even more efficient and safer means than plundering.

But for other Jade Immortals, that might not be the case.

“Would they dare to make a move in an Immortal City?” Lin Yuan asked.

In Cangwu Immortal City, countless killing formations are laid out, and even Jade Immortals must tread carefully, especially so in the Cave Mansion Area, and more so in the top-tier cave mansion where Lin Yuan resides.

Being the highest-grade cave mansion in Cangwu Immortal City, it naturally places great emphasis on safety.

“The Immortal City is indeed enveloped in killing formations, but they are not absolutely perfect. These formations are also laid out by Jade Immortals, so there’s a possibility to unravel them,” said the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall truthfully.

The Immortal Realm is vast with innumerable methods. It is true that the Immortal City is backed by the Ancestral Master, but after he created irregular rifts connecting to the Origin of the Immortal Realm, he stopped intervening in governance.

The establishment and perfection of the Immortal City rely on many Jade Immortals.

Those killing formations were created by numerous Jade Immortals, and under such circumstances, the advice from the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall is quite reasonable.

If Lin Yuan were just an ordinary Jade Immortal, he wouldn’t need to consider these matters. To have any hope of unraveling an Immortal City’s killing formations would require significant sacrifices.

The cost alone far exceeds the entire fortune of an ordinary Jade Immortal, not to mention the risk of being detected by the killing formations of the Immortal City at any time, potentially provoking a joint suppression by numerous Jade Immortals.

But Lin Yuan…

Although it is unknown exactly how much wealth Lin Yuan has, just the earnings from refining the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill lately have far surpassed those of an ordinary Jade Immortal.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan nodded, “I’ll consider it.”

In fact, Lin Yuan does not plan to hire any top Jade Immortals to protect himself.

It would be too troublesome, and there’s also the risk of exposing his own secrets.

The reason why the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall suggested hiring top Jade Immortals was due to being unaware of Lin Yuan’s strength.

The outside world only knows Lin Yuan is skilled in alchemy, a top-tier Alchemy Master. In fact, what Lin Yuan is best at is combat, especially since obtaining the sixth Physical Body Divine Ability, ‘Rend Heaven’.

As for whether he will truly encounter plunder… Lin Yuan is somewhat looking forward to it; who ends up plundering whom is not yet certain.

On this journey through, Lin Yuan has set a tone for himself to stay as low-key as possible, but if someone actively offers themselves up, Lin Yuan can only gratefully accept.

…

The Thirty-Three Immortal Domains.

The Beizhou Immortal Domain.

This is a vast Immortal Domain adjacent to the Xuantian Immortal Domain.

In the depths of an ancient mountain range, a figure in a beast robe sat cross-legged, exuding a terrifying aura from the Barbarian Wilderness.

“It was just the slaughter of one of your scions; do you need to hunt me so persistently? You, a great City Lord, with so many scions, what does killing one of them change?”

This figure in the beast robe shook his head slightly. Not long ago, he killed a scion of the Lord of North Cold City within the North Cold Immortal City for some crucial resource.

This act directly enraged the Lord of North Cold City, who instantly had countless killing formations cover the Immortal City. If not for the beast-robed figure’s innate ability to blend into formations, he likely wouldn’t have escaped the North Cold Immortal City.

Even so, the figure in the beast robe was still issued a warrant by the North Cold Immortal City, with all the Immortal Cities in the Beizhou Immortal Domain searching for him.

“Forget it.”

“I cannot stay in the Beizhou Immortal Domain any longer,” the figure in the beast robe thought quietly to himself. Even though his skills could allow him to escape from the warrant over and over again, he couldn’t keep this up indefinitely.

And as a Jade Immortal, he too needed various resources for cultivation. Being wanted throughout the entire Beizhou Immortal Domain meant that he couldn’t enter those Immortal Cities to purchase resources.
